conviction_note: Near-balanced: the CFO's Sept 8 reset of FY26 ACV growth to ~10% (made with two of Q3's three months in hand) and an upside-paid skew sit against primary-document arithmetic showing reported ACV was flat for two quarters ($1,608m Dec -> ~$1,617m Mar -> $1,620m Jun), so merely holding 7% y/y in Q3 needs ~$46m net new ACV against Q2's ~$3m, plus a quarter-end dollar headwind; abs_move 16 from the 15.9% implied move and 15.0% median reaction, p_up 47 because the bar is partly unsourced and the lean is arithmetic, not a leaked number. impact_sum (-0.6) and the scaled number (-0.96) agree in sign and size.
bar: Q3 2026 non-GAAP EPS $0.45 and revenue $429.0m (Earnings Whispers, https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/pega; whisper $0.48); a second calendar cites $0.30-0.32 on what looks like a GAAP basis, so the EPS bar is single-sourced/disputed. No published Q3 ACV consensus found; the operative bar is the CFO's Sept 8 statement that FY2026 ACV growth will land 'near 10%' vs the 15% Feb guide (https://quartr.com/events/pegasystems-inc-pega-citi-s-2026-global-tmt-conference_ozupZ2vf; https://www.tikr.com/blog/pegasystems-stock-has-fallen-46-in-a-year-heres-where-the-stock-could-go), which implies Q3 ACV y/y of roughly 8-9% (my inference). Company does not re-guide quarterly (Q2 call, https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-21-pegasystems-inc-stock/). Every finding capped small because the quarter bar is not sourced to a company guide or two agreeing estimates.
positioning_check: Short interest 8.08% of float, 2.6 days to cover (Equibles summary, no settlement date, ~Aug 2026, https://equibles.com/stocks/PEGA); Curved Trading shows 11.4m shares short and 7.4 days to cover at the 2026-08-14 settlement (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/pega/short-interest/); Benzinga 13.7% short float on a different denominator (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/PEGA/sentiment). No October settlement found. Moderate, not crowded. Options: 25d skew -3.0 vol pts (calls bid, 'upside paid'), put/call OI 0.58, ATM IV 77.4%, event-implied move 15.93%. Stock has rebounded ~36% off the post-Q2 low ($25.78 premarket 2026-07-22 to $35.16 spot); Earnings Whispers PEAD +38.4% since July 21; 20d run-up only +1.3%.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-08 (Citi TMT conference) CFO Ken Stillwell said FY2026 ACV growth will land near 10%, down from the 15% guided in February, blaming a slower pipeline build and an outbound new-logo motion begun only in late June; he said deal cycles take several quarters, which limits near-term acceleration. Said with July and August of Q3 already booked, a reset to 10% (vs. 8% cc at June 30) implies he expected Q3/Q4 net new ACV to accelerate sharply and lowers the odds of a further guide-down on the Oct 20 call; the same remarks say new-logo work will not help Q3, so the ramp rests on the back-half-weighted renewal book.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The ACV line and the forward warning drove -16.0% on 2026-07-21 (ACV 7% vs 12% prior quarter, AI-delay warning) and -11.85% on 2026-02-10; ACV acceleration drove +14.97% (2025-10-21, ACV +14%) and +28.78% (2025-04-22). The stock closed $37.63 on 2026-09-15, a week after the reset, i.e. it did not fall on the cut.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the cut is six weeks old and the stock held its rebound through it. What is not obviously priced is the timing signal: a CFO re-guiding in the third month of the quarter after refusing to re-guide on the July call ('we've stayed away from the pattern') suggests the 10% is set to be hit. If the market fully trusted it, the skew would be more strongly call-bid and the stock would not have drifted from $37.63 to ~$35.
findings.independence: Same remarks reported by TIKR (https://www.tikr.com/blog/pegasystems-stock-has-fallen-46-in-a-year-heres-where-the-stock-could-go, updated 2026-09-17) — same event, not independent. Q2 call: 'We certainly would expect ACV growth to accelerate ... through the back half' and renewal portfolio 'significantly weighted toward the back half' (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-21-pegasystems-inc-stock/).

findings.finding: Primary-document ACV arithmetic: total ACV was $1,608m at 2025-12-31, ~$1.62bn at 2026-03-31 (+12%) and $1,620m at 2026-06-30 (+7%), i.e. roughly zero reported net new ACV in H1 2026; Q3 2025 ACV was $1,557m (+$43m sequential). Holding 7% y/y in Q3 requires ~$1,666m (~$46m net new, ~15x Q2's ~$3m); a reacceleration to ~9% (the path to the CFO's ~10%) needs ~$1,697m (~$77m). A Q3 net new in line with last year's $43m would print ~6.8% reported, a further deceleration in the headline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: ACV deceleration 12% -> 7% sent the stock -16.0% on 2026-07-21; ACV +14% in Q3 2025 bought +14.97%.
findings.why_not_priced: Sell-side models carry the arithmetic, but the stock has rallied ~36% off the July low and the skew pays for upside, which reads as the market leaning toward reacceleration; if the size of the required Q3 ramp versus a flat H1 were weighed, puts would be bid and the rebound would not have held. Partly priced; filed small because no Q3 ACV consensus is sourced.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 ACV $1,557m from the Q3 2025 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1013857/000101385725000217/q32025_ex-991.htm); Q1 2026 ACV ~$1.62bn +12% from TIKR (https://www.tikr.com/blog/pegasystems-has-lost-46-in-2026-heres-where-the-stock-could-go). Q2 call: 'It's just going to be very challenging to make up the gap that we already experienced in the first half' (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-21-pegasystems-inc-stock/). Shares the ACV line with the finding above but a different document and opposite reading: both can be true (the ramp is required and the CFO says it is coming).

findings.finding: Quarter-end FX headwind on reported ACV and revenue: the euro fell to $1.1312 on 2026-09-29, its lowest since May 2025, with the dollar up ~2.5% on the euro in September and set for a third straight quarterly rise; versus ~1.17 a year earlier this is ~3% y/y. Pega reports ACV as-reported and constant currency and Q2 already showed a 1-point gap (7% vs 8% cc), so the Q3 headline ACV is likely ~1 point below cc and sequential net new ACV is reduced by translation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No release isolates an FX reaction; the market has looked at cc alongside as-reported (Q2 7%/8%).
findings.why_not_priced: Macro, visible to anyone, and offset by the cc disclosure; small. It matters only because headline ACV growth is the first number algos and wires print.
findings.independence: Cambridge Currencies: DXY 98.61 -> 100.98 in just over two weeks to 2026-09-25 (https://cambridgecurrencies.com/us-dollar-index-dxy-forecast/). Proxy: macro-to-company transmission not confirmed by the company.

findings.finding: Revenue has missed for two quarters running: Q1 2026 revenue $430.0m vs ~$467m (-8%), Q2 $420.7m vs $427.4m, with total and subscription revenue more than 4% short of estimates both quarters per Finviz; Q3 consensus $429.0m implies +12.5% y/y over Q3 2025's $381.4m, which itself was boosted by term-license recognition as the cloud mix shift continues to defer upfront license revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 revenue miss of ~8% with ACV +12% drew only -4.61% (2026-04-21); Q2 miss with ACV deceleration drew -16.0%. Revenue misses alone have been damped; ACV carries the reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at $429m sits above Q1 and Q2 actuals, so the Street has not fully marked down revenue despite two misses; but the market has shown it trades ACV not revenue, so this is capped small, and the bar is single-sourced.
findings.independence: Q1 miss detail in TIKR (https://www.tikr.com/blog/pegasystems-has-lost-46-in-2026-heres-where-the-stock-could-go); Q3 2025 revenue $381.35m from 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1013857/000101385725000217/q32025_ex-991.htm); consensus from https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/pega.

findings.finding: Closest competitor Appian reported on 2026-08-07 (after Pega last reported) cloud subscription revenue +23%, total revenue +19%, raised FY2026 guidance, and said AI demand pushed its pipeline above expectations with 85% of new customers on AI tiers; IBM's CEO said on 2026-07-23 that about a third of Q2's delayed enterprise deals had already closed. Both point to demand for workflow/process automation existing, consistent with Pega's 'execution, not demand' framing, though Appian strength can also mean share taken from Pega.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No cited instance of PEGA moving on Appian prints.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since August and likely part of the rebound off the July low; filed small as a proxy. If the market read it as share loss the stock would not have recovered 36%.
findings.independence: IBM CEO remarks (https://www-ak-ms.foxbusiness.com/media/ibm-ceo-addresses-wall-street-tech-panic-after-delayed-enterprise-software-deals-surge-back, 2026-07-23). Proxy, not company-confirmed.

findings.finding: Capital return: Pega repurchased 8.9m shares for $367m in H1 2026 (more than 80% of Q1 FCF returned) under a $1bn authorization extended to June 2027; buying in Q3 around $33-38 versus ~$41 average in H1 would shrink the share count and support non-GAAP EPS against the $0.45 bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Large buybacks accompanied the -16% July reaction without cushioning it; no evidence the stock pays for buyback news on print day.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q3 pace is not public until the release/10-Q; a new authorization or accelerated pace would be news. Partly priced since the programme is known.
findings.independence: Q2 call summary: repurchased ~9m shares for more than $360m (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/pegasystems-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-07-22/); $1bn authorization (https://www.tikr.com/blog/pegasystems-has-lost-46-in-2026-heres-where-the-stock-could-go).

findings.finding: Appian litigation costs for 2026 are now estimated at $70-90m against ~$30m previously modelled, pushing 2026 FCF below the $575m February guide; management calls it 'very much episodic' with no repeat expected in 2027-28 and the retrial in Q1 2027. This lowers reported Q3 FCF/operating margin but has no path to ACV.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No cited print where legal cost alone moved the stock.
findings.why_not_priced: Disclosed at the Sept 8 conference and likely in models; a one-off below the line the stock trades on, so sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: Q2 call: 'any ACV shortfall puts pressure on our ability to hit that $575' (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-21-pegasystems-inc-stock/).

findings.finding: Positioning into the print: the stock is ~36% above the post-Q2 low ($25.78 premarket 2026-07-22 to $35.16), Earnings Whispers shows +38.4% post-earnings drift since July 21, and the option market pays for upside (25d skew -3.0, put/call OI 0.58) — the bar for 'enough' recovery has risen, and the last three prints were all down (-16.0, -4.61, -11.85).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 2025 rally into prints the stock still rose (+14.97, +13.92, +28.78) when ACV accelerated; in 2026 each print fell.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is by construction in the price; the claim is only that the rebound raised the bar. Short interest (8% of float, 2.6-7.4 days) is moderate, so a squeeze is not the base case either way. Sized small because the skew points the other way.
findings.independence: July low and drawdown in TIKR (https://www.tikr.com/blog/pegasystems-stock-has-fallen-46-in-a-year-heres-where-the-stock-could-go); short interest https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/pega/short-interest/.

findings.finding: Product and analyst-recognition flow since July: Infinity '26 GA (2026-07-14, 'predictable AI costs' pricing aimed at the token-cost freeze Trefler blamed), Forrester AI-platforms Leader (2026-08-06), FedRAMP Class D expansion (2026-08-05), Coforge partnership (2026-08-28), DKB customer case (2026-09-01), Gartner BOAT Magic Quadrant Leader (2026-09-21), and a July FAA order for Pega Government Platform licences up to $4.55m via CDW.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None; product PR has not been a print-day driver.
findings.why_not_priced: Public PR, priced; filed because Infinity '26's fixed AI-cost pricing directly targets the stated cause of the H1 freeze, and any Q3 commentary that it unlocked deals would land on ACV.

baseline_tension: The slight negative lean (ACV arithmetic, quarter-end dollar, revenue misses, rebound into the print) cuts against the call-bid skew (-3.0) and the 36% rebound off the July low; the skew is mild and short interest moderate, so p_up is held near 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar single-sourced/disputed, no Q3 ACV consensus): revenue-miss finding cut -0.5 -> -0.3; all findings kept small
Rule 7 (sign against the call-bid skew, short interest looked up and moderate): ACV-arithmetic finding -1.0 -> -0.8 and positioning finding -0.5 -> -0.3
Rule 2 (one-off with no path to the guide): Appian legal-cost finding -0.3 -> -0.2
'Asking what the market missed generates pessimism' / rule 3: p_up moved 46 -> 47, expected_move -1.28 -> -0.96
